115_622a8e5a-9652-465a-a02e-0ac9712da7ab.name: HistoValidationPiece
115_622a8e5a-9652-465a-a02e-0ac9712da7ab.description: Evaluates a trained histopathology segmentation model on a labelled validation set. Computes per-class Dice, IoU, pixel accuracy, and a confusion matrix. Saves an HTML report with metric tables and comparison images.

model_path.description: Path to best_model_path or model_path from HistoTrainingPiece
model_path.title: Model Path

output_dir.description: Directory to save validation report and visualizations
output_dir.title: Output Dir

class_mapping_json.description: JSON class mapping — connect class_mapping_json from HistoTrainingPiece
class_mapping_json.title: Class Mapping Json

class_names.description: Class names in class_id order — connect class_names from HistoTrainingPiece or re-enter
class_names.title: Class Names

max_viz_images.description: Maximum number of comparison images to save in the report
max_viz_images.title: Max Viz Images

mean_dice.description: Mean Dice score across all classes
mean_dice.title: Mean Dice

report_path.description: Path to the HTML validation report
report_path.title: Report Path

112_0d2f08e9-1ed1-406d-9444-30d3dd8433a2.name: HistoTrainingPiece
112_0d2f08e9-1ed1-406d-9444-30d3dd8433a2.description: Trains a 2D semantic segmentation model (UNet / UNet++ / FPN / DeepLabV3+) on histopathology images. Uses segmentation-models-pytorch with albumentations augmentation, AdamW optimizer, and Dice/CE loss. Supports dry_run for fast pipeline validation.

val_samples.description: Validation set from HistoDataSplitPiece (used for per-epoch Dice tracking)
val_samples.title: Val Samples

output_dir.description: Directory to save trained models, checkpoints, and training logs
output_dir.title: Output Dir

image_height.description: Height to resize images/masks before training. Match your patch_size — default 256 for MoNuSeg patches, 512 for beetle/pituitary.
image_height.title: Image Height

image_width.description: Width to resize images/masks before training. Match your patch_size — default 256 for MoNuSeg patches, 512 for beetle/pituitary.
image_width.title: Image Width

early_stopping_patience.description: Epochs without improvement before stopping (0 = disabled)
early_stopping_patience.title: Early Stopping Patience

save_checkpoint_interval.description: Save a numbered checkpoint every N epochs
save_checkpoint_interval.title: Save Checkpoint Interval

max_saved_val_images.description: Max prediction images saved per validation epoch
max_saved_val_images.title: Max Saved Val Images

num_workers.description: DataLoader workers (keep 0 inside Docker to avoid shared-memory issues)
num_workers.title: Num Workers

dry_run.description: Quick smoke-test: forces 1 epoch and 4 samples so the full pipeline can be validated without real training
dry_run.title: Dry Run

model_path.description: Path to the final model .pth file
model_path.title: Model Path

best_model_path.description: Path to the best model (highest val mean Dice)
best_model_path.title: Best Model Path

final_train_loss.description: Training loss at the last epoch
final_train_loss.title: Final Train Loss

116_9b26b821-58c0-49bb-9d46-f615c72ae657.name: HistoDataLoaderPiece
116_9b26b821-58c0-49bb-9d46-f615c72ae657.description: Discovers and validates paired histopathology image/mask files. Scans two directories and returns the list of matched pairs ready for downstream EDA, training, and inference pieces.

images_path.description: Absolute path to the directory containing histopathology images (PNG/JPG/TIF)
images_path.title: Images Path

masks_path.description: Absolute path to the directory containing RGB segmentation masks. Masks must share the same filename as their corresponding image.
masks_path.title: Masks Path

SampleInfo.description: A single image/mask pair in the histopathology dataset.
SampleInfo.title: SampleInfo

images_path.description: Validated path to images directory (passed through for HistoEDAPiece)
images_path.title: Images Path

masks_path.description: Validated path to masks directory (passed through for HistoEDAPiece)
masks_path.title: Masks Path

samples.description: List of matched image/mask pairs — connect to HistoPatchExtractorPiece or HistoDataSplitPiece
samples.title: Samples

126_470021bb-9f7c-4728-b2ae-2c7cfc8e15ab.name: HistoEDAPiece
126_470021bb-9f7c-4728-b2ae-2c7cfc8e15ab.description: Exploratory data analysis for histopathology segmentation datasets. Computes per-class pixel distributions, image dimension statistics, and generates a sample gallery HTML report.

images_path.description: Path to images directory (connect images_path from HistoDataLoaderPiece)
images_path.title: Images Path

masks_path.description: Path to masks directory (connect masks_path from HistoDataLoaderPiece)
masks_path.title: Masks Path

max_eda_images.description: Max images to scan for pixel-level statistics
max_eda_images.title: Max Eda Images

gallery_samples.description: Number of image/mask pairs in the visual gallery
gallery_samples.title: Gallery Samples

report_path.description: Path to the HTML EDA report
report_path.title: Report Path

117_1ff87e86-6362-4a6f-8cb3-22c7af883cce.name: HistoInferencePiece
117_1ff87e86-6362-4a6f-8cb3-22c7af883cce.description: Runs inference with a trained HistoTrainingPiece model on histopathology images. Saves RGB prediction masks, optional comparison figures, and computes Dice scores if ground-truth masks are provided.

test_samples.description: Test set from HistoDataSplitPiece (masks optional — Dice computed if present)
test_samples.title: Test Samples

output_dir.description: Directory to save prediction masks and comparison visualizations
output_dir.title: Output Dir

class_names.description: Connect class_names from HistoTrainingPiece or re-enter
class_names.title: Class Names

save_comparison_images.description: Save side-by-side comparison images (input | prediction | ground truth if available)
save_comparison_images.title: Save Comparison Images

max_comparison_images.description: Maximum number of comparison images to save
max_comparison_images.title: Max Comparison Images

predictions_dir.description: Directory containing RGB prediction mask files
predictions_dir.title: Predictions Dir

num_images_processed.description: Number of images inference was run on
num_images_processed.title: Num Images Processed

mean_dice.description: Mean Dice score (only set when test_samples include mask_path)
mean_dice.title: Mean Dice

dice_per_class.description: Per-class Dice scores (only set when masks available)
dice_per_class.title: Dice Per Class

122_896367b7-6545-4627-a016-6d1ec21c717f.name: HistoDataSplitPiece
122_896367b7-6545-4627-a016-6d1ec21c717f.description: Splits a histopathology SampleInfo list into train / val / test subsets. Supports random or sequential splitting with a configurable seed. Outputs three SampleInfo lists that connect directly to HistoTrainingPiece, HistoValidationPiece, and HistoInferencePiece.

samples.description: List of image/mask pairs from HistoDataLoaderPiece or HistoPatchExtractorPiece
samples.title: Samples

train_ratio.description: Fraction of samples assigned to the training set
train_ratio.title: Train Ratio

val_ratio.description: Fraction of samples assigned to the validation set
val_ratio.title: Val Ratio

test_ratio.description: Fraction of samples assigned to the test set (remainder after train+val if ratios don't sum to 1.0)
test_ratio.title: Test Ratio

split_strategy.description: 'random' shuffles samples before splitting; 'sequential' preserves filesystem order

val_samples.description: Validation set — connect to HistoTrainingPiece and HistoValidationPiece
val_samples.title: Val Samples
